violation_type.title: Documented annual training - Employee prior to accompanying a child to a swimming pool (26 TAC §744.1318(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Documented annual training - Employee prior to accompanying a child to a swimming pool
violation_type.typical_finding: Four employees who accompany children to pools away from the operation did not have water safety training.

finding_variants.text: Four employees who accompany children to pools away from the operation did not have water safety training.
Four caregivers that were present at the pool had not completed a water safety training course.
